content.short: Opencord is a Web3-native social platform built for DAOs.
content.description: Opencord provides a one-stop workflow for DAOs and Web3 communities, making it easy to create and manage organizations much like setting up a group chat. Proposals, discussions, and voting are centralized across channels such as chat, voice, and forums, while servers can be personalized with built-in DAO tools and DApps. The project aims to connect DAOs, DApps, and members to broaden Web3 access, pursuing a progressively decentralized ecosystem built, operated, and owned by users, with tokenomics that support growth in an open, inclusive environment.
